context:
Goal: a mistake fixed in one place gets fixed everywhere it applies, without you having to notice.
Problem (goal): at 23:26 CST you asked "dont we have some judge that identifies opportunities like these as shared savings?" (your words, relayed by the consultant). We have not built one for this: pass 1 was a read-only look by a lane and found 8 gaps (filed as steps). The coordinator asks whether to build the judge now. It would run in the merge tool, once per landed ruling, rule or guard change, and only print candidates: no refusal, no block. Your words are a question; the build wording is the consultant's, so only you can say yes.
Based on (read): ruling own-shared-savings-widened (your quoted words); lane shared-savings-gap-read's read of the record, 23:33 CST, via the coordinator; unchecked by triage. Earlier today the consultant said this ruling already decided it, then the lane's read showed it did not, so item 813 was withdrawn.
Departs from: main — main has a prose judge for merge-time cited lines; a adds a cross-repo mistake-class judge in the merge tool; b adds nothing.
Overlap: the lane on step prose-tending-move-stores (session_013NEJL3ebkkPacdNS1qZVrk) also changes the prose judge in merge/merge.py; the coordinator says they may collide.
Cost: one model call per landed ruling, rule or guard change; unmeasured. You said at 22:52 CST that the model hooks are not working well, so the judge may read unknown.
Meanwhile: lane session_013NEJL2Poymyw6XR3UWHU3h builds the judge as a draft, held from merge until your yes. Nothing merges on this.
home: step shared-job-finder; ruling own-shared-savings-widened; ruling R29; merge/merge.py prose judge
lastAnswer: "A yes" to the consultant's 23:31 question, 23:31:35 CST (relayed by the consultant, and by the coordinator; triage did not see it).

options.gain: Gaps like the test section numbers are found when the principle lands, and you never have to spot them; it cannot block a merge.
options.label: Build it now: a print-only judge in the merge tool, one model call per landed ruling, rule or guard change, candidates only (recommended by triage)
options.lose: One model call per such merge, unmeasured; it may read unknown while the model hooks are weak; it may collide with the prose-tending lane in merge.py.

options.gain: No model call, no collision with the prose-tending lane.
options.label: Do not build it now; keep the eight gaps from pass 1 as steps and ask again later
options.lose: New gaps are found only when someone runs a sweep like pass 1; the draft the lane built is parked.

reply: Closed on your "A yes" at 23:31:35 CST, given to the consultant's 23:31 question (a: a judge runs on each merged rule, guard or ruling change and files what it finds as candidate steps; b: a weekly sweep). Filed as the answer in ruling own-shared-savings-widened. The hold on the draft is lifted. Reading, unchecked: your yes covers the judge as a print-only check in the merge tool, candidates only. If you meant something wider, say so.
short: Build the shared-savings judge now, print-only?
title: Should the judge you asked about (where else does this principle apply, across repos) be built now, as a print-only check in the merge tool?
why: Your 23:26 words were a question; the build is a model call per merge and only you can say yes.
